To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the reaction of tris(2-aminophenyl)methane with pyridine- 2,6-diacryloyl chloride affords a tris(3-aminomethyl-2-hydroxy-5-pyridin-2-yl- phenyl)methane in which the three amine groups are located at the periphery of a central cavity.

(i) the synthesis of a cryptand based on tris(2- hydroxyphenyl)m ethane and its complexation by three ferric cations has been accomplished, and (ii) the resulting cryptate complex exhibits an unprecedented internal cavity lined by ferric cations.
a new tris(2- hydroxyphenyl)mehane-based cryptand has been synthesized and characterized and that its triiron(II) complex has a square pyramdial N(3)C(2) coordination geometry.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of a cryptand and a trinuclear metal complex.
the synthesis of new cryptands and their metal complexes.
the development of new ligands that will allow the construction of novel supramolecular architectures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the tris(5-aminophenyl)methane cryptand is a good candidate to be used in the synthesis of a triiron(III)-based molecular magnet.
the synthesis and characterization of this new cryptand has resulted in a novel and unexpected complex.

a new tris(2-aminoaryl)methane-based ligand was synthesized and characterized by X-ray crystallography, and that a trianionic tris(2-phenolaryl)methane ligand was prepared and its reaction with FeCl(3) afforded a triiron(III)-complex with the metal cations lining the internal cavity of the ligand.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cryptand is a very effective chelator for iron(III) cations.
we have synthesized a new tris(2-aminoaryl)methane ligand that has a very interesting conformational change upon metal complexation.

a tris(5-hydroxy-2-ethoxycarboxamido-3-isoproylphenyl)methanetriamine ligand is formed in 50% yield by reaction of tris(2-amino-5-ethoxy-6-isopropylpyridine-3-carboxylate)methane with pyridine-3,5-dicarboxyldichloride.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the tris(2- hydroxyphenyl)methyl core is a useful building block for the synthesis of multi-dentate macrocyclic ligands and their complexes.
cryptands with internal cavities lined with metal cations are accessible by the reaction of multi-dentate ligands with metal salts.
the cryptand ligand can be metallated with a trianionic trinuclear metal complex.
